name: Chronograph Gp
description: Portfolio monitoring, valuations and analytics for private-capital GP teams using the Chronograph connector: portfolio-company one-pagers, fund quarterly review packs, markup/markdown briefs, TVPI attribution and budget-vs-actuals. Requires a Chronograph account and the Chronograph connector.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills** and **6 agents**.

- **Skills** (5): `chronograph-budget-vs-actuals-variance` (Compare portfolio company operating actuals against budget/plan, compute variances, flag off-plan companies, and roll up to the fund,…), `chronograph-fund-quarterly-review-pack` (Generate a consolidated quarterly review pack for a single fund — a fund-level summary plus a one-pager section…), `chronograph-markup-markdown-brief` (Identify which portfolio companies were marked up or down this period, quantify each change, surface the stated basis,…), `chronograph-portfolio-company-one-pager` (Generate one-pagers and investor reports for private equity portfolio companies), `chronograph-tvpi-attribution-by-company` (Decompose a fund's total value / TVPI into per-company contributions, split realized vs)
- **Agents** (6): `chronograph-budget-vs-actuals-variance` (Budget vs), `chronograph-fund-quarterly-review-pack` (Fund quarterly review agent — builds a consolidated review pack for a single fund with a one-pager section…), `chronograph-gp-analyst` (End-to-end GP portfolio and fund analysis orchestrator — builds portfolio-company one-pagers and LP quarterly updates, fund quarterly review…), `chronograph-markup-markdown-brief` (Markup/markdown agent — identifies valuation changes by holding, quantifies them, surfaces the stated basis, and ranks by NAV…), `chronograph-portfolio-company-one-pager` (GP report builder — generates fully styled, self-contained HTML one-pagers and LP quarterly updates for private equity portfolio…), `chronograph-tvpi-attribution-by-company` (TVPI attribution agent — decomposes a fund's total value into per-company contributions, split realized vs)

Installs with `claude plugin install chronograph-gp@claude-plugins-official` from `chronograph-pe/chronograph-gp-claude-plugin`.
